details:
This update for python-sqlparse fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-54284: TokenList.__init__ materializes O(subtree) value per group, causing CPU DoS before depth/token caps
  trigger (bsc#1275459).
- CVE-2026-59893: Inefficient Regex Handling of Dollar-Quoted SQL Literals Leads to ReDoS (bsc#1275461).
- CVE-2026-59894: Generated Python and PHP snippets allow SQL string breakout through unescaped backslashes
  (bsc#1275460).
- CVE-2026-71491: quadratic O(n2) DoS in group_comments (bsc#1275466).
